notes.title: New Storyline: Letters From Your Son
notes.content: [p]This update brings a completely new [b]player story arc[/b] tied to family and responsibility:[/p][list][*][p]✉️ [b]Letters as a new mechanic[/b] — your son now writes you regularly, sharing his school life, asking for help, or sending funny little updates.[/p][/*][*][p]💸 [b]Meaningful choices[/b] — you can support him with money (full, partial, or none). Every decision affects his feelings and the eventual outcome.[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Crayon drawings[/b] — some letters come with charming childlike sketches, giving the storyline a personal, emotional touch.[/p][/*][*][p]🏠 [b]Finale[/b] — after upgrading to the top-tier home, the last letters decide: will your son stay with his grandmother… or finally come to live with you?[/p][/*][*][p]👦 [b]In-world appearance[/b] — if he joins you, you’ll actually see him at your home.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]⚠️⚠️⚠️ [b]Important:[/b] To fully experience this new storyline, you must [b]start a new game[/b]. Old saves will not trigger the son’s letters.[/p][p align="start"]This story arc adds more than management and kiosks — it’s about family, responsibility, and the choices you make along the way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660969/516d29f8ddebfb3cde492751e613e021d687d592.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Marble Style Upgrade – Counters & Shelves!
notes.content:
[p]Your kiosk can now reach its [b]maximum style upgrade[/b] with [b]marble counters and shelves[/b].
This premium look comes in three variants:[/p][list][*][p][b]White marble[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Green marble[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Black marble with golden veins[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Every marble setup is finished with [b]glowing golden edges[/b] to make your kiosk stand out even more.
Go full monochrome or mix styles — either way, customers won’t be able to resist![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660969/a2440fb7ce966e306f6b7540a198ccbd60459fef.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Lure Sounds Updated!
notes.content:
[p]We’ve listened to your feedback about the customer lure sounds — and made changes!
The old “psst” and cough sounds are gone, replaced with friendly and varied voice lines like “Hey!”, “Yo!”, “Hello!” and more.[/p][p align="start"][b]What’s new:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Replaced all lure sound effects with cleaner, natural-sounding voice lines.[/p][/*][*][p]More variation so it doesn’t feel repetitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced volume and distance so you can hear them clearly without being too loud.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Try calling out to a passing customer now — it feels much better![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660969/8e23cded7e622d53a4c196509b1c0a4ad681287b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Zombie Weekend Update — Zombies Can Hurt You Now!
notes.content: [p]🧟‍♂️ [b]Zombie Weekend just got deadlier![/b][/p][p]Zombies are no longer harmless background danger — they [b]can hurt you[/b] now.[/p][p][/p][p][b]HP System.[/b] You start the night with [b]10 hearts[/b]. Every hit from a zombie removes [b]1 heart[/b]. Lose enough, and you’ll be in real trouble.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Too Close = Damage.[/b] Keep your distance. If they get in hugging range, you pay the price.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Night Changes Everything.[/b] The red moon rises, eerie fog drifts in, and regular customers vanish. Automation takes a break — it’s on you to keep things under control.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Smart survival tips[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Stock up.[/b] Make sure your shelves aren’t empty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keep moving.[/b] Don’t let the dead box you in near corners.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mind your route.[/b] Always have a clear path back to safety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Watch your hearts.[/b] A greedy detour can cost you precious HP.[/p][/*][/list][p]Will you survive the night and keep your kiosk safe?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660969/49e7133b30ae353c2f0a917026012bd9ad970d58.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Neon Lights & Modular Upgrades — Customize Your Kiosk Like Never Before!
notes.content:
[p]In this major visual update, we’re giving you more power to stand out in the crowded street market.[/p][p]🟣 [b]Neon Sign System[/b]
Add personality to your kiosk with glowing neon signs! Two distinct styles are available — unlock them both and switch between them at any time. Only one neon type can be active at once, so choose wisely and set the mood with custom colors.[/p][p]🧱 [b]Modular Upgrades[/b]
Take kiosk customization to the next level. Each part of your kiosk — the [b]counter[/b], [b]display stands[/b], [b]rolling shutters[/b], and [b]roof[/b] — can now be upgraded with new shapes, materials, and visual effects.[/p][p]🎨 [b]Cosmetics with Meaning[/b]
These upgrades aren’t just for looks. Your kiosk’s appearance directly affects foot traffic: decent customers won't even approach a dirty, rundown shack! Want more visitors? Invest in style.[/p][p]📈 [b]Kiosk Tier Impacts Popularity[/b]
Each visual upgrade contributes to your kiosk’s prestige level. The higher your prestige, the better your daily traffic — and the more high-paying customers you attract.[/p][p]🏗️ [b]Fully Integrated UI[/b]
Switch out parts in the new customization panel, with real-time preview, localization, and persistent saves.[/p][p]Whether you're going for a sleek modern cart, a retro candy truck, or a chaotic neon-lit snack factory — now’s your time to shine.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660969/d42cd52bf6e1633e6914feae0623afb4243432fc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Illegal Kiosk Trailer is Out — Refilling Just Got Risky
notes.content:
[p][b]“I want to refill.”[/b][/p][p]Sounds innocent, right? But when an alien whispers that phrase under a purple sky — things are never that simple.[/p][p]In our latest [b]gameplay trailer[/b], we’re pulling back the curtain on the [i]Illegal Kiosk[/i] — a shady, high-risk operation that only opens after dark.[/p][p]🛸 Serve suspicious customers.
💸 Make serious profits.
🚨 And when the siren hits… shut the kiosk [i]fast[/i], or it’s game over.[/p][p]Activate warp shields. Outsmart the cops. Build it all again — or lose everything.[/p][p]▶️ [b]Watch the new trailer now and remember: staying late can be... unexpectedly rewarding.[/b][/p][p][i]— Choco Kiosk Simulator dev team[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660969/b874c715d0cd54fb08ec365775483fde9a90179f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Achievements Added!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve just added a full set of 16 Steam achievements to Choco Kiosk Simulator!
You can now see all the shiny icons and challenge descriptions right on the game’s Steam page.[/p][p][b]Why add them now?[/b]
We want you to get a taste of the challenges, give feedback, and (of course) start theorycrafting how to unlock them all! Achievements will be fully functional and unlockable in the release version. For now, in the playtest, they are here for your browsing pleasure and planning.[/p][p][b]What does this mean for playtesters?[/b][/p][list][*][p]The achievements list is live, but you won’t be able to unlock them just yet — backend integration will come with the main release.[/p][/*][*][p]If you notice anything strange with achievement names, icons, or descriptions, let us know in the discussions![/p][/*][*][p]Got ideas for unique or funny achievements? notes.title: Update: Charm Nearby Customers With a Subtle "Psst"!
notes.content:
[p]We've added a brand-new [b]attraction mechanic[/b]:
When a customer is wandering nearby, you can [b]press \[E][/b] to make a subtle sound — a gentle cough, a polite "mmm?", or a quiet "ah!" — and [b]try to lure them[/b] toward your kiosk.[/p][p]🎯 If your kiosk has matching products, and luck is on your side, the customer will stop, reconsider... and join your queue![/p][p]This isn’t some crude finger snap or catcall. Our in-game voice prompts are respectful, charming, and fully localized. Want more styles of "psst"? Tell us on the forums!

🎁 [b]What's included in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]✅ 6 elegant voice cues added (psst, hmm, ah, cough, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Raycast-based interaction: point at the customer and press \[E][/p][/*][*][p]✅ Customers will evaluate nearby kiosks for matching items before responding[/p][/*][*][p]✅ UI hint system added for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]✅ No physical colliders used — elegant and optimized[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💡 Pro Tip:[/h2][p]If your kiosk is clean and stocked, customers are more likely to respond.
Otherwise… they may just keep walking 👀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45660969/af9115d2b3ea4cf2fd39b68784bf905a3df0987d.png"][/img][/p]
